jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Full Stack (.NET/React) (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Role

As part of our development team, you will be responsible for the further development of our enterprise software for marketing automation. With this solution, our more than 200 customers from a wide range of industries control their digital marketing campaigns at every touchpoint - automated, individualized and intelligent based on AI.

Your mission:

You take on a leading role within the development team, mentoring colleagues, sharing your expertise, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
You actively scout, evaluate, and champion emerging technologies, frameworks, and best practices, driving innovation and shaping the strategic technical direction of our products
You lead by example in architectural decisions and complex problem-solving, taking ownership of cross-cutting initiatives and ensuring the long-term scalability, maintainability and quality of our software solutions
As part of our agile software development according to Scrumban, you will create complex software systems in the C# programming language on the Microsoft .NET platform and work with the latest technologies such Claude Code
You will advance our company's capabilities in agentic coding, shaping the future of AI-driven development
You will be responsible for everything from conception and development to integration into our system landscape, using many Azure DevOps options: version management with Git, test plans, build and release
You will actively engage with current cloud technologies and develop cloud-based web applications with real-time requirements and enable the hosting of our web applications in MS Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS)
You work on framework conditions of the software development process such as design, planning, estimates and code reviews and see yourself as an advisor to the development team consisting of Product Owner, Full Stack Developers, SQA Engineers and the Helpdesk as a support team for our customers

Your profile:

Excellent C# skills with a deep understanding of modern software design and object-oriented principles
Strong experience with both relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database technologies
Proven experience working with cloud platforms and developing cloud-native applications
Solid working knowledge of Docker and container-based deployment
Comprehensive expertise in both current .NET versions and the legacy .NET Framework, enabling you to work confidently across modern and established codebases
Experience with AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot **or** OpenAI Codex
Good communication and teamwork skills
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

RiskConsult GmbH is a leading provider of risk management solutions for large-scale projects worldwide. Our innovative software is utilized by industry leaders and consulting firms to ensure project success through comprehensive risk assessment and mitigation strategies. With a focus on continuous development and technological advancement, we strive to deliver reliable, efficient, and user-friendly tools that support our clients in navigating complex project environments. Our team is committed to excellence, fostering a collaborative and forward-thinking work culture that encourages technical innovation and professional growth.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated .NET / WPF Software Developer to join our dynamic development team in Innsbruck. In this role, you will be instrumental in enhancing our desktop application, a sophisticated WPF-based solution built on the .NET framework. Your primary responsibility will be to contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of our risk management software, ensuring it remains robust, scalable, and aligned with user needs. You will work closely with project managers, UX designers, and clients to implement features, improve existing functionalities, and ensure the highest quality standards are met. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a developer passionate about creating elegant and maintainable code in a collaborative environment, with the chance to see your work directly impact our clients’ projects worldwide.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate possesses a genuine enthusiasm for programming and a strong foundation in software development. You should have a completed technical or scientific education, such as a degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (e.g., HTL, architecture). Demonstrable experience in C# and the .NET ecosystem is essential, preferably with hands-on experience in WPF application development. If you have developed personal tools or projects using similar technologies, this will be considered advantageous. Excellent communication skills in German (C1/C2 level) are required, as all technical documentation and team communication are conducted in German. Proficiency in English is a plus. You should enjoy working collaboratively, communicating openly, and continuously learning to improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team.

Responsibilities

Participate in the ongoing development of our WPF desktop application, including working on the data model, backend logic, and user interface design using XAML and MVVM architecture.
Refactor legacy code to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability, ensuring the application remains up-to-date with current standards.
Implement and expand unit and integration tests to guarantee the reliability of existing and new features, supporting continuous integration processes.
Develop auxiliary tools and utilities that enhance the main application’s functionality and user experience.
Create comprehensive technical documentation and user help guides to facilitate ease of use and future maintenance.
As your product knowledge deepens, provide support and engage in direct communication with partners and clients to address technical questions and gather feedback for further improvements.

Benefits

Structured onboarding process with direct coding involvement, enabling you to quickly familiarize yourself with our codebase and development practices.
Opportunities for professional growth as your understanding of our products increases, with increasing responsibilities and influence on architectural decisions.
Regular feedback from project managers and clients, allowing you to see the tangible impact of your work in real-world applications.
Flexible working hours within a Gleitzeit model, supporting a healthy work-life balance, with options for remote work and home office arrangements.
Modern, centrally located office spaces in Innsbruck, directly opposite the Olympiaworld, providing a comfortable and inspiring work environment.
Competitive salary starting from EUR 4,000 gross monthly based on 14 salaries, with potential for higher compensation based on experience and expertise.

Equal Opportunity

RiskConsult GmbH is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our goal is to attract talented individuals from diverse backgrounds and provide them with equal opportunities to succeed and grow within our organization.
